---
title: "Suspension"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

dashboard <- read_csv(here("data/ca_dashboard.csv"))

suspension <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(indicator == "suspension") |>
  select(
    reportingyear,
    rtype,
    countyname,
    districtname,
    schoolname,
    charter_flag,
    student_group_long,
    indicator,
    color,
    currstatus,
    change,
    currdenom,
    currnumer,
    statuslevel
  )

solano_suspension <-
  suspension |>
  filter(countyname == "Solano")

district_colors <- c(
  "Benicia Unified" = "#c19b6a",
  "Dixon Unified" = "#6cc033",
  "Fairfield-Suisun Unified" = "#44a22b",
  "Travis Unified" = "#000066",
  "Vacaville Unified" = "#962c40",
  "Vallejo City Unified" = "#f7b915",
  "Solano County Office of Education" = "#8B0000"
)

```

```{r}
#| label: suspensions_in_solano
#| echo: false

max_year <- max(solano_suspension$reportingyear)

solano_suspensions_all_students <-
  solano_suspension |>
  filter(
    is.na(charter_flag),
    rtype == "D",
    student_group_long == "All students"
  )

sus_labels <-
  solano_suspensions_all_students |>
  filter(reportingyear == max_year)

solano_suspensions_all_students |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reportingyear,
    y = currstatus / 100,
    color = districtname,
    group = districtname
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_label(
    data = sus_labels,
    aes(label = districtname)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = district_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_minimal()

```
